contexts.text: Not in him but with him.
It is not said in Beerlahairoi, but with Beerlahairoi. Explained.
They who are in the Heavens are said to be in the Lord... AC 8192:2.
All the Angels are not only with the Lord, but in the Lord; or, what is the same, the Lord is with them, and in them...
What proceeds from the Lord... is not in Him, but is from Him.
Heaven and Hell... are in man.
They who love the Lord are conjoined with Him, insomuch that they are said to be in him, when they are in Heaven.
He then comes into Heaven, because... this conjunction is Heaven with him...
That which is solely in the understanding is indeed with the man, but is not in him...
Esse and Existere from itself involves a beginning... but Esse and Existere in itself is from eternity...
The sense of the letter... in sum.
That the Divine Esse is Esse in itself; and, at the same time, Existere in itself.

It cannot be said that His Esse is from itself, because this... supposes what is prior... and also another God, who is God in Himself... From the fact that God is Esse in itself, it follows that He is love in itself, wisdom in itself, and life in itself...
That God is not only Esse in itself, but also Existere in itself. Explained.
